description.p: Glyph is an intuitive, modern desktop utility for Linux that allows you to easily customize application icons across your system without requiring root permissions.

ul.li: Browse and search through all installed desktop applications
Set custom app icons from local SVG or PNG files
Safely manage overrides at the user level without touching system files
Instant one-click restore back to default system icons
Test launch applications directly to verify changes
Clean, adaptive design built with GTK4 and Libadwaita

description.p: Hardened Flatpak sandbox, strict file permissions, and GNOME 50:

ul.li: Updated base platform and SDK runtime to GNOME 50
Hardened Flatpak sandbox: replaced overreaching host:ro with scoped host-os:ro, granting read-only access strictly to host packages while completely locking out /home and personal files
Strict granular permissions: restricted write access solely to user launcher overrides (~/.local/share/applications) and custom icons (~/.local/share/glyph)
Added read-only access for user icon themes (xdg-data/icons:ro)
Enhanced host application catalog and icon discovery inside the sandbox via /run/host/usr
Set custom icons from SVG or PNG
